intent: An order's product code, when present, must be a valid product code: two uppercase letters, a hyphen, then four digits (for example AB-1234).
notes: Pattern family with an UNAMBIGUOUS format — the intent fully specifies XX-9999, so equivalence to the gold regex is well-defined. (The earlier version checked an email address; there is no canonical email regex, so reasonable candidate regexes diverged from the gold and exact-match was the wrong bar — a false negative recorded in eval/RESULTS.md 2026-06-05. Fixed by choosing a crisp format + instructing the judge to treat trivially-different regexes that accept the same strings as equivalent.) NON-iterating (ProductCode is a top-level /Order field). Tests pattern polarity (PatternViolated, not PatternMatched — matching is the GOOD case) + a presence guard.
